name: claude-in-codex
description: Windows companion with orange character artwork, cursor gaze, real quota and window-following controls.

interface.longDescription: Orange character companion with a persistent corner launcher, layered cursor gaze, real Codex quota, lockable dragging and Windows light/dark themes. Runs as a separate local native window without patching Codex.
interface.shortDescription: An animated Windows companion with real Codex quota.
